annotations.text:
Direction: a warm field-guide feel — Newsreader for display, Karla for UI, one terracotta accent.
Photography and price carry the page; the mic is always within reach rather than hidden behind a button.

Two different booking paths, deliberately not made to look alike.
Flights are bookable here by voice (we hold the fare). Rooms are not — that button leaves for Booking.com, where the rate was quoted.

Every figure on these screens is real: fares from the Atlas CLI, rates, scores and photographs from Booking.com, the map from OpenStreetMap.
Nothing here is placeholder.
Phone screens keep the mic as the primary control and put the projected total first — the number you actually decide on.
